## Mathematical disposition

**4600045 / AMR-045-0045 remains UNRESOLVED, Approach 1/5.** This proof-only edition publishes an accepted partial exclusion theorem and its complete mathematical audit. No surjective cellular automaton with strict sub-full upper exponential jointly periodic growth is constructed, and no additional proof-search turn or novelty claim is made.

For F(a,b)_i=(a_(i+1), b_i+c(sigma^i a)b_(i+1)+d(sigma^i a)) on (B x F_q)^Z, with arbitrary finite-range control functions c,d, the map is surjective and J_k(F)=sum_a q^(k-r(a)), where r(a) is the zero multiplicity of product_i(t-c_i)-1. In characteristic p, r(a)<=(q-1)p^(v_p(k)); consequently nu(F)=sq=N. The entire stated scalar controlled-affine family is excluded as a strict-growth construction.

The full mathematical argument preserves compactness surjectivity, the shift-adjusted fixed-fibre reduction, affine Fitting decomposition, small-ring overlap, all-period counts without orbit division, extension-field/characteristic distinctions and positive-characteristic derivative cancellations. Both sharper special cases and the binary liminf trap remain. The independent mathematical audit additionally retains its algebraic sharpness argument for q-1. Arbitrary nonlinear dynamics and more general controls or fibre operators remain outside the result.

## Attribution, repairs and acceptance

The original target is Boyle–Lee Conjecture 1.4 / Boyle Conjecture 25.5. Public sources: [Boyle–Lee manuscript](https://math.umd.edu/~mboyle/papers/18nov2006.pdf), [published article](https://doi.org/10.1080/10586458.2007.10129005), and [Boyle's open problems](https://www.math.umd.edu/~mboyle/papers/openfinalsub3nov2007.pdf).

The literal Boyle–Lee linear result uses cyclic-alphabet addition; the prime-field one-track zero-affine-term specialization is credited accordingly. Broader fields and controlled alphabets use the self-contained proof. The final audit uses only the qualitative prior full-growth conclusion, not incidental quantitative claims. Both closed repairs, a missing Fitting-display TeX backslash and this literal citation-scope clarification, are retained. No mathematical repair remains for the accepted partial.

The proof and audit are AI-assisted and unrefereed. Acceptance is not external human peer review or proof-assistant certification. No novelty, publication priority or exhaustive literature-status certification is claimed.

## Publication boundary

Exactly eight files are added under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/4600045/`. Every theorem and proof passage and the complete mathematical audit are retained, with a closed repair ledger and public-source metadata. The independent-diagnostics section is removed in full. Administrative/private-input wording and bindings are adapted to the distributed edition; no omitted computation is converted into replacement prose.

No source bodies, extracts, images, datasets, scripts, checkers, standalone computation results/logs, private files or identities of omitted authored/private/computational artifacts are included. Public scholarly PDF hashes, sizes and citation/retrieval/inspection metadata remain. No QUEUE.md, unrelated file or historical accounting changes are included. This is draft-only; no merge, release, DOI deposit or external outreach is part of this change.

## Preparation checks

The final accepted proof, audit and repair ledger were read and their exact input hashes checked. All original author/audit manifest entries and retained public PDF identities match. Exact editorial diffs and byte-preserved mathematical blocks are recorded locally. The eight-file manifest, allowlist, UTF-8/JSON, relative links and excluded-material scans pass. Strict-whitespace clean additive replay reproduces the exact files and bytes; complete base/expected ancestor Git trees are independently rehashed with all unrelated entries, including the QUEUE blob, preserved. These are packaging checks; no CI pass is claimed. Exact-head remote readback is a separate publication check.
